To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we propose an irregular grid for the solution of linear elliptics, we prove that the scaling technique is efficient for the solution of the linear elliptic partial equations on the irregular grid, we present numerical results to support the theoretical findings.

a symmetrically geometrically proportion grid with respect the boundary is proposed for the numerical solution to the linear elliptic partial different equations, a scaling technique for the coefficient matrix obtained from the second-order center difference discretization on irregular grid is proposed, the condition number of symmetrically scaled coefficient matrix is bounded by a positive constant for the one-dimensional problem, and the same conclusion also holds for a two dimensional problem.

the symmetric scaling technique can be applied to an irregular grid to obtain a symmetric coefficient matrix with a bounded condition number for the solution of linear elliptical partial differential equations.

the irregular grid and the symmetric scaling technique, which is of theoretical and practical importance for solving linear elliptic partial difference equations.
